item.title: Video: Demilight Version 0.8
item.description: It's been quite awhile since the mini-moving light project (now renamed The Demilight) has been written up on the blog. The project was in hiatus for a few months while dove into the technical challenges of a new job, but as the job isn't keeping quite as busy at the moment (here in early summer 2020), it's back on the workbench. I've put together a video showcasing the current state of the project, now in version 0.8:
